{{Quote|Oh, dear. You say the engine needs a new supply of space crystals? And they can only be found in the deepest cave on this planet? Then let's go!|C-3PO, to R2-D2|<ref name="Shiny" />}}
A terrestrial '''planet''' was the site of a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] with a deposit of [[space crystal]]s. At one point, the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] while traveling on a single-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Unidentified gold spacecraft|starship]]. After obtaining [[space crystal]]s from the cave, the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] traveled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
[[File:Gold_spacecraft-Shiny_as_a_Droid.jpg|250px|thumb|left|C-3PO and R2-D2 inspect the spacecraft]]
At one point, the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] visited the '''[[Planet/Legends|planet]]''' while traveling on a single-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Unidentified gold spacecraft|starship]]. About to blast off for [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], they discovered that the engine of their starship needed a new supply of [[space crystal]]s. Since they could only be found in the deepest cave on the planet, the two droids set out to search for them. The droids came through a narrow [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] pass, where they put the [[Unidentified giant serpent|giant serpent]] to sleep. They hurried away from a [[Unidentified hairy clawed plant|large clawed plant]] in a slimy [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]. Then, as they passed through a dark [[Forest/Legends|forest]], a [[Unidentified four-armed creature|four-armed creature]] pointed them in the right direction. Eventually, the droids found the crystals and took them back to their spacecraft to load them into the engine. After that, they were able to continue their journey.<ref name="Shiny" />

==Behind the scenes==
This planet appeared as the place where the entire story of [[Shiny as a Droid: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from a Galaxy Far, Far Away|''Shiny as a Droid'']], a [[1986]] children's book written by [[Virginia Holt]] and illustrated by [[Feito]], took place.<ref name="Shiny" />
